description: This file defines a singleton factory class 'JWTFactory' that creates instances of JWT token objects, either using the SecapiToken implementation or a Web::JSONWebToken, based on compile-time configuration. It also manages secret key initialization when Secapi is disabled.

classes.name: JWTFactory
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for creating JWT token instances, managing a secret key, and providing a thread-safe way to generate token objects with different implementations depending on compile-time options.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of JWTFactory.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a JWT token object, either SecApi or Web::JSONWebToken depending on compile-time flags.
